IMAGE 1 is the NEW COMPLETE ABSTRACT POSE GUIDE. IMAGE 2 is the accepted LUNA IDENTITY MASTER. White chains are the bright NEAR left limbs; dark chains are the dark FAR right limbs. Cyan/yellow lines, joints, floor/root marks, circles, arrows, text and the canvas are instructions ONLY and must NEVER appear in the final person image. The guide is freshly authored full-pose geometry, not a cut or rotated person. Draw one natural COMPLETE PERSON in the pose, with the identity, armor, head-shell size and body mass of image 2. Preserve the near bright rear/LEFT leg and far dark front/RIGHT leg order through loading, extension and landing. Both lower legs are plain red/silver suit: NO BLUE shin fins, calf plates, greaves or blue boot armor. 回idle前保留很小真实屈膝/双臂收势差；近亮后左、远暗前右全程不换脚。
透明背景。Draw ONE NEW complete whole-body arcade pixel sprite of ULTRAMAN ARC LUNA ARMOR, LAND PHASE 01/01. Fixed side-view camera. The fighter begins and ends facing SCREEN RIGHT; during a somersault the full body, head and face rotate together in the fixed side-view plane. ONE person, ONE distinct whole-body pose.
IMAGE 2 is the accepted LUNA IDENTITY MASTER. Use it for the actual armor silhouette, anatomy, low swept silver crest and its opening, yellow eye, cyan chest lamp, ice-blue moon chest/shoulder armor, both circular wrist disks, red/silver suit patterns, material colors, body proportions and arcade pixel finish. This is the moon armor itself, never the base Arc body recolored or armor pasted on another person.
Permanent depth identity: the NEAR left arm and leg are BRIGHT SILVER, the FAR right arm and leg are DARK SILVER. Trace each entire shoulder-elbow-wrist-fist and hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-boot chain continuously. During rotation do not change a limb identity merely because its screen position changes. Exactly TWO complete arms, TWO hands, TWO legs and TWO full boots attached naturally to ONE complete chest/pelvis. No duplicate limbs, third leg, spare shoe, detached armor or ghost poses.
COMMON landing recovery, immediately before the accepted idle guard. Keep both complete boots planted and the SAME final leg order as the reference: BRIGHT NEAR leg extends BACK/LEFT and DARK FAR leg remains FRONT/RIGHT. Extend both hips and knees out of the landing compression, raising the chest and both shoulders together. Both elbows and disks settle into the reference guard, near forearm across the abdomen and far fist under the chin. Keep a small real settling difference from idle; do not copy the static master, reuse backstep recovery, lift one foot into a run or leave an arm frozen.
Redraw the ENTIRE PERSON together in this new pose. Both arms, both shoulders, chest, hips and both legs must participate in the phase; do not animate only one hand, paste a limb, rotate a cut-out, splice separate body parts, locally recolor a base figure or cover a static person with effects. Use the master body/head proportions even when the pose is curled, upside-down or horizontal; do not enlarge the head or torso to fill the square or fit the pose silhouette to a fixed area.
Natural continuous suit surfaces at the shoulders, elbows, wrists, waist, hips, knees and ankles. Keep the designed armor segmentation; remove toy ball joints, insertion seams, toy hinge holes, screws, stands, mold lines and plastic highlights. Both wrist disks belong to their own forearms and must follow the complete arms. Do not turn the disks into generic floating effects or invent equipment.
Crisp 32-color arcade pixel clusters, stepped dark outlines, upper-left light, strong near/far separation; no photographic skin/metal texture, soft blur, smooth SVG/vector finish or realistic 3D render. Preserve the head-shell size and body mass from the identity image for later COMMON whole-source 1024-to-159 sampling; no per-limb or per-phase area fitting. Full head crest, both hands, BOTH full boots and every armor tip inside generous transparent margins.
True RGBA transparent PNG, 1024x1024, high quality. Background must be actual Alpha transparency, not checkerboard. No ground shadow, ground plane, labels, grid, skeleton, pose guide, other people, weapon, speed lines, beam, dust, aura or Q/charge effects. Do not bake whole-person translation, a jump height arc or a second lift into the sprite: the real integer simulation supplies world travel. 空白处必须真Alpha透明，不画棋盘格。
